alt: A person in a wide-legged forward bend over a mat while a man sits down on a bolster in the foreground
subject: A person in a white top and maroon trousers holds a wide-legged forward bend over a mat with a dowel on the floor, then a man in a yellow kurta sits down on a bolster in the foreground with his back to the camera.
qualityNotes: A clear sustained action followed by a teacher entering the frame - a genuine arc. Steady and correctly coloured. The foreground figure becomes very large at the end of the clip, so the last two seconds are best trimmed. A small shrine cabinet is visible in the background.

alt: A man guiding a woman through a chair-supported pose, steadying her leg
subject: A man in a yellow kurta guides a woman in a red top through a chair-supported pose, steadying her leg as she works.
qualityNotes: The clearest hands-on teaching in the clip set - the teacher's hands are visibly working. Short, steady, good colour separation between the yellow kurta and the red top. Mirror behind adds confusion.

alt: A person hanging inverted from wall ropes against a plain wall, then lowering down
subject: A person in a pink top hangs inverted from wall ropes against a cream wall, then lowers down and steps away.
qualityNotes: A complete action - hanging, descending, stepping off - against a plain wall with almost nothing else in frame. Rare clarity for this set. The wall is a flat, slightly dirty cream.

alt: A person holding an inverted position over a folding chair against a pale wall, then folding down
subject: A person holds an inverted position over a folding chair against a pale wall, legs vertical, then slowly folds down.
qualityNotes: Single figure, plain wall, no other people, and the descent gives the clip a natural end. The face is hidden behind the chair throughout, which makes it the safest clip in the set to publish.

alt: A person lying on a bolster with legs vertical in a supported shoulderstand, then lowering down
subject: A person in a pink top lies on a bolster with legs vertical in a supported shoulderstand beside a folding chair, then lowers the legs and comes down, while someone crouches at the left.
qualityNotes: Complete arc from held inversion to rest, steady throughout, correctly tone-mapped. A second person crouches at the left edge for most of the clip and a hand enters the bottom of frame at the end. The turquoise curtain and warm yellow wall are a strong colour pairing.

alt: Close green leaves moving gently in daylight, filling the frame with overlapping blades and stems
subject: Close green leaves move gently in daylight, filling the frame with overlapping blades and stems.
qualityNotes: The only pure nature clip in the archive and by far the best transition or background loop: no people, no branding, gentle continuous movement, and it loops without an obvious cut. Highlights on the leaf edges are close to clipping.

alt: A man holding a wide standing pose with one arm raised while three people stand watching
subject: A man in a green top holds a wide standing pose with one arm raised on a mat while three other people stand watching at the left of a pale room.
qualityNotes: Steady, well exposed, with a clearly held pose and onlookers who give it the feel of a demonstration. Framed tall so the figures sit low; a framed notice on the wall is legible at full size.

alt: Two women raising their arms overhead beside a man in a pale shirt, then bending sideways towards chairs
subject: Two women stand on mats with their arms raised overhead while a man in a pale shirt stands between them, then all move into a side bend reaching towards folding chairs.
qualityNotes: A clear two-stage movement - arms up, then side bend - with a teacher standing among the students. Steady. The hall is bright and low in contrast and the figures are small in a tall frame.

alt: A woman folding forward holding a wooden dowel, then rising to standing with it stretched overhead
subject: A woman in a pink top and dark trousers folds forward over a mat holding a wooden dowel, then rises to standing with the dowel stretched overhead, a strap under her feet.
qualityNotes: One person, one continuous movement, steady camera, and the wooden dowel and foot strap make the alignment work legible. Strong contrast between the pink top and the yellow wall. The window behind is slightly blown and another practitioner's legs enter at the left edge.

alt: A person holding an inverted position against a wall while a man supports them and helps them down
subject: A person holds an inverted position against a pale wall on a mat while a man in a white shirt supports and then helps them down.
qualityNotes: A full supported inversion from entry to exit with a helper clearly present - the most complete teaching arc in the clip set. Steady. Plain pale wall behind, slightly grey.

alt: Three people lying back over folding chairs in a row in supported backbends
subject: Three people lie back over folding chairs in a row in supported backbends, arms hanging behind them towards the mats, in a pale room with a doorway and a wall hanging behind.
qualityNotes: A row of held shapes with all faces hidden by the chairs, which makes it easy to publish. Steady, correctly coloured. Very little movement, so it reads almost as a still. A person walks through the background at one point.

alt: A class moving through a wide standing pose with arms extended on mats across a hall
subject: A class of five or six people move through a wide standing pose with arms extended on mats across a yellow-walled hall, a teacher moving among them.
qualityNotes: One of only two landscape clips in the archive, and the only one showing a whole class moving in unison - exactly the shape a wide hero band needs. The camera drifts a little and a hand enters the right edge at one point. Warm yellow cast.

alt: A man steadying a person holding an inverted position with their back to a wall, legs vertical
subject: A man in a patterned shirt steadies a person holding an inverted position with their back to a wall, legs vertical above a mat, a folding chair and a dowel beside them.
qualityNotes: Unambiguous supported inversion with the teacher's hands visibly taking weight. Steady, correctly coloured. Short - about six usable seconds. A blue water bottle and a bag sit prominently in the lower foreground.

alt: A man moving through a wide standing pose with one arm raised on a mat in a long pale room
subject: A man in a dark top and trousers moves through a wide standing pose with one arm raised on a mat in a long pale room, two other people standing at the far end and a small pennant on the wall.
qualityNotes: The cleanest single-figure practice clip in the set: a full movement with a clear beginning and end, steady camera, correct colour. A small wall pennant with an emblem hangs at the right and two people stand watching at the far end; both are minor and crop away. The room is pale and low in contrast.

alt: A man sitting down cross-legged on a mat in a bright hall beside a printed roll-up banner
subject: A man in a pale shirt sits down cross-legged on a mat in a bright hall and settles into stillness, with a tall printed roll-up banner and a blue-curtained doorway behind him.
qualityNotes: A man sitting down and becoming still is exactly the right movement for a breath or meditation section, and it is the only clip in the archive that does it. Steady, correctly tone-mapped. BUT a tall printed roll-up banner stands directly behind him for the whole clip, carrying a logo, photographs, body text and a QR code, all legible at full size. It must be cropped out or the clip must not be used.

alt: A paved courtyard under dense overhanging trees edged by a low red pierced-concrete wall
subject: A paved courtyard under dense overhanging trees, edged by a low red pierced-concrete wall, with a man crouching at the far side and dappled light moving across the stone.
qualityNotes: Green, shaded and gently moving - the best transition clip after the leaf close-up, and correctly tone-mapped. It is not unpeopled: a man crouches at the far edge for part of the clip, small and not identifiable. Shot on another institution's campus, but nothing identifying is in frame. Deep shadows are close to blocking up.
